comparison_scope: Open-loop cross-implementation consistency only; not real-world validation and not bit determinism.
input_definition: bcod-sim propeller command is converted to its applied propeller thrust in newtons; that same per-step thrust and the same rudder angle in radians are sent to Gazebo.

cases.description: positive constant thrust and positive rudder
positive constant thrust and negative rudder
piecewise propeller/rudder sequence matching the existing Vehicle B production probe

pass_rule: Every metric must pass in every case; no tolerance may be revised after observing Gazebo results.
negative_control: Reverse the sign of converted Gazebo yaw; the directional and yaw metrics must fail.
